text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp of our third year 
began. Last year, North Flight was 
thrilled to take on intensive training, 
but—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah! That swimwear is so cute!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This time, she showed enough composure to 
refresh herself in the shopping area 
before training.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A collage of various patterns— that 
kitschy design really catches the eye, 
doesn't it?
choice_data_list:
That's pretty flashy considering it's your 
choice.

That's pretty flashy coming from your 
tastes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, really? Even so, I find myself 
deeply drawn to it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps... it reflects how I feel right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A feeling of wanting to choose a swimsuit 
collaged with all kinds of animal 
prints...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's exactly how I feel!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Just like last year, I want to grow a lot 
during summer training camp...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
With a ROAR, I will seize victory over 
Bakushin O-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Preparing for yet another showdown with 
Sakura Bakushin O... our heated summer 
training camp began.
